wa_east_ridge_9.notes: Serpentine peridotite with minimal pro — much of it is slippery enough that cams pull out easily; the pitch forces you rightward back into the gully.
First gendarme traverse; a crack on the right provides protection, with an option to straddle the ridgeline on knobs.
Featureless rock heads right to the ridge crest, belaying off a large sling-protected boulder.
Knife-edge ridge traverse — stay climber's left; a horn provides sling protection.
Long, exposed class 3 walking traverse to the base of the final vertical rock.
The route's crux: an obvious fist-jamming crack, right foot in the crack and the other smearing while jamming fists — a large cam or hex is key gear.
